standfirst: Every feature the Bornaviridae module declares, the profiles behind it, and what fraction of its own collection each one recovers. The family is six proteins — N, X, P, M, G and L — plus the nucleocapsid's p38 isoform, the glycoprotein's predicted signal peptide and its two furin subunits, and two glycoprotein-derived ORFs that only one genus carries. L has no profiles at all: it is spliced, and is called from 120 literature-anchored nucleotide references. Built 17–18 November 2026; every citation on this page is model-proposed and awaits a curator.

modules.Bornaviridae: One module for the whole family. Gene content is identical in Orthobornavirus, Carbovirus, Cultervirus and Cartilovirus; only the order differs (M and G are transposed outside Orthobornavirus, and Cartilovirus inserts two extra ORFs), and order does not enter a profile. 16 reference contigs route 100% of the 218 near-complete genomes.

why.N: The 38/39 kDa nucleocapsid doublet, the most abundant protein in infected cells (PMID 9188580). The 38 kDa alternative-initiation isoform is deliberately not a feature: it is an exact C-terminal substring of the 39 kDa form, nothing in BV-BRC deposits it, and the second in-frame Met sits at residue 14 in only 69 of 129 collection members, so no fixed offset is derivable.
why.X: The non-structural X protein (p10), encoded by an ORF overlapping the 5' end of P and a negative regulator of polymerase activity (PMID 15992626). Nine of its eighteen profiles exist only because the coverage run found X uncalled in every non-Orthobornavirus genus; a tenth was recovered by ORF-calling a genome that deposits no X at all.
why.P: The polymerase cofactor p24 (PMID 9268312). Four truncated deposits that begin 19-40 residues inside the protein were dropped before the profiles were built, after check_met_start flagged a cluster whose members start with Gly.
why.M: Matrix protein; the crystal structure shows a tetramer that binds single-stranded RNA (PMID 19237566).
why.G: The envelope glycoprotein precursor p57, glycosylated to gp94 and cleaved by furin (PMID 9557754).
why.G_N: The mature N-terminal furin subunit, GP-N or GP1, with the signal peptide removed: residues 20-249 of the 503 aa BoDV-1 precursor. Its 230 aa is an independent corroboration of the layout -- about 27 kDa deglycosylated, which is what Kiermayer 2002 measured when GP-N was finally detected in infected cells (PMID 12417322). Both of its ends are cleaved, so both extensions are 0.
why.G_C: The C-terminal furin product, GP-C / gp43 / GP2, residues 250-503 of the BoDV-1 precursor and the membrane-anchored subunit (PMID 9557754, PMID 9060684). It runs to the precursor's own stop, so only its N-terminus is a cleaved end.
why.L: The 190 kDa polymerase (PMID 10756058). It is a SPLICED feature with no PSSMs: in Orthobornavirus a 17 nt first exon is joined to the main ORF across a 1,294 nt intron, and the module carries 120 nucleotide references instead of profiles. A PSSM CDS was built first and rejected because it put up to 46 spurious residues on the N-terminus.
why.VP1: Cartilovirus only: an ancient duplication of the glycoprotein gene (PMID 38028148). One genome exists in the whole of BV-BRC, so this is a single-sequence profile and its bit cutoff was measured, not defaulted.
why.VP2: Cartilovirus only: a second duplication, 44% identical to Vp1 (PMID 38028148). Also a single-sequence profile.
why.N_PRIME: The p38 isoform of the nucleocapsid, called N' in the literature (PMID 30541858), translated from the second initiation codon and lacking the 13-residue PKRR nuclear localization signal that keeps p40 nuclear (PMID 9188580). Its collection is derived by aligning every N and cutting at the Met homologous to BoDV's measured Met14. Because it is an exact C-terminal substring of N, nothing but a measured bit cutoff separates them: 440, in the gap between 510 (weakest true call) and 380 (worst false one).
why.G_SP: The glycoprotein's N-terminal signal peptide, predicted with SignalP 6.0 and then cut back by three gates: one cluster withheld for failing to recall its own training sequences above a caller's floor, two more withheld for disagreeing with GP_N about where the mature protein starts, and a bit cutoff of 36 set from the measurement that higher-scoring calls tile the precursor exactly and lower-scoring ones drift. It calls on about a third of genomes and is exact wherever it calls. No bornavirus signal peptide has been determined experimentally, so this is a prediction.

derived: G_N and G_C have no collection of their own. Nothing in BV-BRC is annotated as a mature bornavirus glycoprotein, so both products were cut out of the G collection at the furin site rather than collected. Richt 1998 (PMID 9557754) places that site after the arginine at position 249 of the 503 aa BoDV-1 precursor; the derivation here finds the single R-X-[K/R]-R match in the 40-62% window and extends it through the basic run, which reproduces residue 249 exactly and generalises to every genus.

L's references are literature-anchored, not deposit-derived. Walker 2000 (PMID 10756058) places intron II at nt 2410-3703 of strain V with the initiator AUG at nt 2393, a 17 nt first exon. Every junction built here was required to round-trip -- cut the reference at its own declared coordinates, translate, and reproduce a clean Met-initiated ORF -- and the measured intron, 1,282-1,294 nt across 107 genomes, reproduces the published 1,294.
gaps: Three lineages have no L reference and so get no polymerase call: a 6,115 nt Parrot bornavirus 3 contig that cannot hold the gene, Canary bornavirus 1 (its only L deposit does not match its own contig cleanly), and Carlia munda bornavirus, whose L begins at a near-cognate TTG codon.
N' rests on a 1.16× cutoff margin, the narrowest in this module, because it is an exact C-terminal substring of N and no other signal separates them.
Vp1 and Vp2 rest on one genome each, which is every Cartilovirus genome that exists in BV-BRC.

The signal peptide is a prediction and is carried only where it is tight. SignalP 6.0 is installed here and now works -- its model weights had never been converted in and were restored from the licensed tarball already on disk -- but a verified cut is not automatically a good feature. Two clusters were withheld for disagreeing with GP_N about the mature start, and the bit cutoff keeps only calls that tile the precursor exactly. The feature therefore calls on 11 of 36 exemplars rather than all of them.
